prompt: Create a Python 3.12 inventory application. Products have name, category, price and quantity. Users must be able to search by name, filter by category, specify a maximum price and specify a minimum quantity. All filters must be combinable.

intentions.text: I can search for products by name
intentions.observable: a list of products matching the name

intentions.text: I can filter products by category
intentions.observable: a list of products in the specified category

intentions.text: I can specify a maximum price to filter products
intentions.observable: a list of products with price less than or equal to the maximum price

intentions.text: I can specify a minimum quantity to filter products
intentions.observable: a list of products with quantity greater than or equal to the minimum quantity

intentions.text: I can combine multiple filters (name, category, maximum price, minimum quantity) in a single query
intentions.requires: a product name, a category, a maximum price, and a minimum quantity
intentions.observable: a list of products matching all specified filters
